# Write Error Cases — type validation errors

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# --- Unknown type: type not in templates ---
stdin ../unknown-type.md
! exec akb write unknown-type.md
stderr 'unknown type'

# --- Missing type field entirely ---
stdin ../no-type.md
! exec akb write no-type.md
stderr 'missing required field .type.'

# --- Missing title field ---
stdin ../no-title.md
! exec akb write no-title.md
stderr 'missing required field .title.'

# --- Empty frontmatter ---
stdin ../empty-fm.md
! exec akb write empty-fm.md
stderr 'empty frontmatter'

# --- No frontmatter at all ---
stdin ../no-fm.md
! exec akb write no-fm.md
stderr 'no frontmatter found'

# --- Stdin required (no pipe) ---
! exec bash -c 'akb write no-stdin.md </dev/null'
stderr 'input required'

-- unknown-type.md --
---
type: nonexistent
title: Test
---
Content

-- no-type.md --
---
title: No Type
---
Content

-- no-title.md --
---
type: note
---
Content

-- empty-fm.md --
---
---
Content

-- no-fm.md --
Just some content without frontmatter
